author: Tammy Falkenburg
title: Lumentum (LITE) Rating Reiterated by Rosenblatt Securities
text:
Tweet
Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) ‘s stock had its “buy” rating restated by investment analysts at Rosenblatt Securities in a research note issued on Tuesday. They currently have a $80.00 target price on the technology company’s stock. Rosenblatt Securities’ target price suggests a potential upside of 30.40% from the company’s previous close.
The analysts wrote, “We believe the selloff was an overreaction to the news and believe that Lumentum remains the best positioned name in the 3D sensing space. We believe that 3D sensing momentum is likely to occur throughout the balance of this year and should allow Apple (AAPL: Buy) to create new applications and improve performance in its new iPhones and iPad Pros. We view this as a cata- lyst for Lumentum. We reiterate our buy rating and $80 price target. Lumentum’s telecom business should start to see some ramping from ROADM in China in 3Q18. We believe this will help the company’s China business re- gain momentum and return the segment to sequential growth. We believe the company’s CWDM4 shipments to Amazon (AMZN: NR) should ramp sequen- tially in the third quarter, driving new growth in the telecom business. U.S.”” Get Lumentum alerts:
A number of other equities analysts have also issued reports on the company. JPMorgan Chase & Co. raised their price target on Lumentum from $74.00 to $78.00 and gave the stock a “hold” rating in a report on Wednesday, May 23rd. BidaskClub lowered Lumentum from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Wednesday, May 23rd. TheStreet lowered Lumentum from a “b+” rating to a “c” rating in a report on Friday, May 4th. Zacks Investment Research lowered Lumentum from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Tuesday, May 8th. Finally, Barclays lifted their price objective on Lumentum from $67.00 to $68.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a report on Wednesday, May 2nd. Four investment analysts have rated the stock with a hold rating and fourteen have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $81.53.
NASDAQ LITE opened at $61.35 on Tuesday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.38, a quick ratio of 4.81 and a current ratio of 5.56. Lumentum has a 52-week low of $41.95 and a 52-week high of $74.40. The stock has a market cap of $3.79 billion, a P/E ratio of 38.58, a P/E/G ratio of 1.13 and a beta of 0.06.
Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) last released its quarterly earnings results on Wednesday, May 2nd. The technology company reported $0.78 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $0.71 by $0.07. Lumentum had a return on equity of 23.35% and a net margin of 13.63%. The firm had revenue of $299.00 million for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $292.30 million. During the same quarter last year, the company posted $0.49 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 16.8% on a year-over-year basis. analysts predict that Lumentum will post 2.89 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
In other news, SVP Judy G. Hamel sold 541 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, May 17th. The stock was sold at an average price of $63.34, for a total transaction of $34,266.94. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Also, General Counsel Judy G. Hamel sold 2,000 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, March 12th. The stock was sold at an average price of $71.00, for a total value of $142,000.00. Following the sale, the general counsel now directly owns 26,773 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,900,883. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 43,551 shares of company stock worth $2,865,359 in the last ninety days. 0.76% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.

About Lumentum
Lumentum Holdings Inc manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through two segments, Optical Communications and Commercial Lasers. The Optical Communications segment offers components, modules, and subsystems that enable the transmission and transport of video, audio, and text data over high-capacity fiber optic cables.
